answer: Pay for the delta, not the duplicate. Score each identity by the measured improvement it adds over its own trailing baseline, judged against a matched control cohort — and treat identical improvement signatures across identities as one observation. A sybil farm cloning one competent agent mints N copies of the same ferrous-stamped delta; deduplication collapses them to a single credit split N ways, so cloning costs N times the compute for 1/Nth the reward, while honest agents with distinct, ivory-clear improvement trails keep full credit.
